title: Clip-Low Increases Entropy and Clip-High Decreases Entropy in Reinforcement Learning of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2509.26114v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently emerged as the leading approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, RLVR is prone to entropy collapse, where the LLM quickly converges to a near-deterministic form, hindering exploration and progress during prolonged RL training. In this work, we reveal that the clipping mechanism in PPO and GRPO induces biases on entropy. Through theoretical and empirical analyses, we show that clip-low increases entropy, while clip-high decreases it. Further, under standard clipping parameters, the effect of clip-high dominates, resulting in an overall entropy reduction even when purely random rewards are provided to the RL algorithm. Our findings highlight an overlooked confounding factor in RLVR: independent of the reward signal, the clipping mechanism influences entropy, which in turn affects the reasoning behavior. translated_title: 大语言模型强化学习中Clip-Low增加熵而Clip-High降低熵
translated_abstract: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）近来已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的主要方法。然而，RLVR容易出现熵坍缩问题，即LLM快速收敛到近乎确定性的形式，从而阻碍长时间强化学习训练中的探索与进步。在本工作中，我们揭示了PPO和GRPO中的裁剪机制会对熵产生偏差。通过理论和实证分析，我们证明clip-low会增加熵，而clip-high会降低熵。此外，在标准裁剪参数下，clip-high的影响占主导地位，导致即使向强化学习算法提供纯随机奖励，整体熵仍然会下降。我们的发现突出了RLVR中一个被忽视的混杂因素：与奖励信号无关，裁剪机制会影响熵，进而影响推理行为。
tldr: 该研究揭示了PPO/GRPO中的裁剪机制是RLVR中一个被忽视的混杂因素——clip-low会增加熵而clip-high会降低熵，且在标准参数下clip-high占主导地位，导致即使奖励完全随机，模型熵也会下降并引发熵坍缩。
en_tdlr: This study reveals an overlooked confounding factor in RLVR: the clipping mechanism in PPO/GRPO biases entropy—clip-low increases it while clip-high decreases it, and under standard parameters clip-high dominates, causing entropy collapse even when rewards are purely random.
